characters.name: Fin
characters.voice_notes: Zei's best friend. Easygoing, joking, loyal and protective; bored by school, later enthusiastic about linguistics and the Bansunpei language project.

characters.name: Zei
characters.age: teen (final year of high school, about 17-18)
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Dzego chapters (full name Zei Leimin). Very bright maths/physics mind, quick and articulate, dry humour, nonchalant about danger, competitive Minpentai player; socially a bit awkward. Devoted to his mother Min.

characters.name: physics instructor
characters.voice_notes: Unnamed Decentralized University teacher. Engaging, Socratic, clear lecturer; stays calm and caring after the bombing; sober and quietly patriotic when explaining Dzego's strategy.

characters.name: young woman at DU
characters.voice_notes: Greets Fin on arrival at the hidden Decentralized University classroom; one friendly shouted line.

characters.name: man at DU stairs
characters.voice_notes: Stops the group at the bottom of the stairs to redirect them to another room; brisk, low-key, matter-of-fact.

characters.name: other student
characters.voice_notes: A classmate who answers two of the instructor's questions; precise, a little studious.

characters.name: student in smoke
characters.voice_notes: A single short reassurance to the instructor after the explosion; shaken but okay.

notes: F and Z here are Fin and Zei (not Febric and Zven as in ch. 1). No letter is shared within the chapter, so no exceptions. 2:82 and 2:84 (O) are the same unnamed second student (male). 2:121 has an instructor run and then one run (S) by an unnamed student. Spoken lines that are embedded in narrator runs (not N-named speakers, so not in narrator_exceptions): 2:63, 2:65, 2:67, 2:69 are answers shouted by about ten students in unison; 2:126 is about ten people replying together; 2:137 is Fin and Zei speaking a Dzegoban slogan in unison. 2:9 and 2:100 are Zei's unspoken thoughts inside narration.
